predecessors.name: Post-Angkor Cambodia
predecessors.text: the Mekong delta and lowlands that Cliopatria's Khmer Empire row loses in 1700 (295 cells, 287 of them in the 'Cambodia' row)

successors.name: Nguyễn lords
successors.text: the delta and the Đồng Nai, Bình Dương and Tây Ninh lowlands of the row (163 of its 271 cells in 1757), drawn as Nguyễn land from 1700

successors.name: Champa
successors.text: Bình Thuận (27 cells) and Ninh Thuận (1), Panduranga, which the row's outline takes in

successors.name: Nguyễn dynasty (Đại Nam)
successors.text: the Nguyễn dynasty's 1803 outline, which covers 270 of the row's 271 cells

ledger.x: 1700: Cliopatria opens a separate 'Cambodia' row on the Mekong delta and the cells around it.

certainty.note: The delta frontier with the Khmer core is not given by the pages; the Cliopatria outline is an approximation.
